description: This file contains unit tests for exception safety testing utilities in the Abseil library, including tests for throwing values, allocators, constructors, and exception guarantees.

classes.name: ExhaustivenessTester
classes.description: Template class used to test exhaustiveness of certain operations for different types.

classes.name: NonNegative
classes.description: A simple struct representing a non-negative integer with comparison operators.

classes.name: NonCopyable
classes.description: A non-copyable struct derived from NonNegative, used to test non-copyable types.

classes.name: NonEqualityComparable
classes.description: A struct derived from NonNegative with a method to modify state on throw, used to test non-equality comparable types.

methods.name: ExpectNoThrow
methods.description: Runs a function and expects no exceptions; reports failure if a TestException is thrown.

methods.name: TestOp
methods.description: Tests that a function throws when the countdown hits zero and does not throw otherwise.

methods.name: TestAllocatingOp
methods.description: Tests that an allocation operation does not throw and throws a TestBadAllocException when the countdown hits zero.

methods.name: CheckNonNegativeInvariants
methods.description: Checks that a NonNegative object maintains its invariant (i >= 0).

methods.name: CheckHasResetContracts
methods.description: Checks that the reset method of HasReset sets i to 0.
